dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

King Simba arrived at the shelter very fearful and unsure of his surroundings. Thankfully, he is highly food motivated, which has helped staff begin building trust with him. He has quickly learned that it is safe to come out of his kennel and go for walks with staff-a wonderful step forward!

King Simba is still very sensitive to handling and currently allows only minimal physical contact. Attempts to collar him can cause him to become uncomfortable and escalate to growling, so he will need a patient foster or adopter who understands his boundaries and is willing to move at his pace. A slow, calm approach and plenty of positive reinforcement will be important as he continues to build confidence.

King Simba is also heartworm positive and will need continued veterinary care and treatment as part of his journey to better health.
dog.name: King Simba
